verses: By means of simplest fish trap that men make, Sand blowers small and yellow jaws they take;-- Such the result good rule insures. And here our host his spirits forth has set, Good and abundant; proof we now are met, When ordered rule large wealth secures.

In simplest fish traps that might useless seem, They take abundant store of tench and bream;-- Such issue from our good rule springs. And here our host his spirits forth has set, Abundant, good;--sure proof we now are met, When ordered rule great riches brings.

Into the simplest fish traps largely go Mudfish and carp;--captures that clearly show How with good rule the land is crowned. And here our host his spirits forth has set, Good and most ample;--proof we here are met, When ordered rule makes wealth abound.
The mats in great abundance viands show; And these of rarest quality we know.
The viands excellent are here revealed; Both land and sea their contributions yield.
Viands in ample store the feast displays; And all in season, all beyond our praise.
